title: Lewis Black at Epstein's mansion and the Israeli defense minister

tellings.quote:
Lewis Black's story is so interesting.
He walks in the door. There's a marker
board where they go in and there's all
it looks like football plays or
something.

plain: The comedian Lewis Black once walked into Jeffrey Epstein's New York mansion and saw, just inside the door, a marker board covered in what "looks like football plays or something", in a story that, as it is titled, also involves Israel's defense minister. Kurt Metzger, a comedian, relays it on the show as something Black told, and he also names the comedian Bobby Slayton in the telling. He tells it as a strange glimpse of who passed through Epstein's house and what was planned there.
